mods.name: Spawn-Elytra
mods.description: Allows players to fly and boost in the spawn area

releases.notes:
**Fixes mod loading on 26.2.** Version 1.2.0 fails to start the server, so use this release instead.

## The bug

1.2.0 crashed at startup with:

```
Mod 'Spawn-Elytra' (spawn-elytra) 1.2.0 requires any version of fabric, which is missing!
```

...even with Fabric API correctly installed.

`fabric.mod.json` declared a dependency on the mod id `fabric`. That is not Fabric API's id — its id is `fabric-api`. The old name only ever resolved because Fabric API declared `provides: ["fabric"]` as a backwards-compatibility alias, and that alias was removed in the 26.x line:

| Fabric API | `provides` |
| --- | --- |
| `0.141.3+1.21.11` | `["fabric"]` |
| `0.155.2+26.1.2` | none |
| `0.155.2+26.2` | none |

The dependency now names `fabric-api` directly.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API

Running 26.1.x? Use [1.1.1](https://github.com/Skaimbauer0401/SpawnElytra/releases/tag/v1.1.1), which carries the same fix.

This is a **server-side** mod. It does not need to be installed on clients.

## Commands
All commands require permission level 2.

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/spawnelytra radius <1-1000>` | Set the start radius |
| `/spawnelytra booststrength <0.01-100.0>` | Set the boost strength |
| `/spawnelytra center <x> <y> <z>` | Set the centre position |
| `/spawnelytra default` | Reset all settings |
| `/spawnelytra info` | Show current settings |

No gameplay behaviour changed.

releases.notes:
Support for **Minecraft 1.21.9 and 1.21.10**.

This release captures the final state of the `1.21.9-1.21.10` development line, which has now been converted into this release.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.9 or 1.21.10
- Fabric Loader 0.17.0+
- Fabric API

## Commands
All commands require permission level 2.

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/spawnelytra radius <1-1000>` | Set the start radius |
| `/spawnelytra booststrength <0.01-100.0>` | Set the boost strength |
| `/spawnelytra center <x> <y> <z>` | Set the centre position |
| `/spawnelytra default` | Reset all settings |
| `/spawnelytra info` | Show current settings |

## About the attached jar

The jar was built from this tag rather than taken from the previously published files, because none of the published jars matched this source state exactly.

It is a correct build: it declares `"version": "1.0.2"`, advertises `>=1.21.9 <=1.21.10`, and packages the mod icon. The later 1.21.11 line branched from a commit *before* these fixes and so regressed both of them; they were restored in 1.1.0.

releases.notes:
Support for **Minecraft 1.21.11**.

This release captures the final state of the `1.21.11` development branch, which has now been converted into this release. The attached jar is the original artifact that was published to Modrinth, preserved as-is.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
- Fabric API

## Commands
All commands require permission level 2.

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/spawnelytra radius <1-1000>` | Set the start radius |
| `/spawnelytra booststrength <0.01-100.0>` | Set the boost strength |
| `/spawnelytra center <x> <y> <z>` | Set the centre position |
| `/spawnelytra default` | Reset all settings |
| `/spawnelytra info` | Show current settings |

## Known issues in this build

These are documented for accuracy and are all fixed in 1.1.0:

- The jar declares `"version": "1.0.0"` internally rather than `1.0.3`. The value was hardcoded in `fabric.mod.json` and had drifted from `gradle.properties`, so mod managers could not distinguish this release from earlier ones.
- The mod icon is not packaged. `img.png` was located in `src/main/java` instead of `src/main/resources`, so it never made it into the jar.
- The Fabric Loader dependency floor is stale (`>=0.15.0`).

None of these affect gameplay behaviour.

readmeSummary: Allows players to start flying within a configurable start area. Pressing spacebar whilst flying boosts the player in the direction they are looking. The default center is the world spawn.
